# Security Policy

Filament Holler connects the cameras and microphones of the people in a panel. Please report anything that lets someone ring, join, listen to or watch a call that `canCall()` or the panel's own access rules should keep them out of, or that starts or answers a call without the person clicking.

If you discover a security issue, email [security@packstub.dev](mailto:security@packstub.dev) instead of using the issue tracker. We answer within a few days and credit reporters in the changelog unless they prefer otherwise.

The signaling routes and their checks belong to [packstub/holler](https://github.com/packstub/holler), the browser engine to [@packstub/holler](https://github.com/packstub/holler-js); their policies cover them.
